scope: Local static website and documentation presentation; no claim of external accessibility certification or deployed-server qualification.
method: Headless Chromium through the local Chrome DevTools Protocol, isolated temporary browser profile; read-only page inspection plus native keyboard navigation. Screenshots inspected for desktop homepage, narrow homepage, and Portuguese documentation.

generated_site_check.detail: All 51 generated HTML documents passed local links, anchors, unique IDs, one h1, inactive-asset and staged-download checks.

limitations: No assistive-technology user study or complete manual WCAG audit.
Browser checks sample the listed pages at the listed widths; the build checker covers all generated local page links.
Production HTTPS, response headers and downloadable artifacts require separate deployment validation.
No external hosted font, asset or script was used.
